intent.outcome: Wave 2 — Governed Mission, Work Package, Lease, Evidence and Lifecycle Contracts
intent.normalizedBrief: Implement ROR-23 only after exact ADR ROR-24 acceptance and the Wave 1 gate. Define versioned MissionContract compiled from canonical specs/policies/approvals, mutable revisioned work packages under stable mission authority, execution leases with fencing/expiry/runtime identity/exact repository revision, and canonical immutable policy-definition plus scope-activation/checkpoint/receipt/bundle/delta/dispatch input provenance. Define normalized runtime-neutral execution/activity events, host-observed evidence envelopes, closeout/lifecycle decisions, cancellation acknowledgements, and plan-change proposals. PostgreSQL remains canonical; Git is code truth; Rorca memory is advisory; MCP is an optional generated projection, not federation protocol. Include migrations, API schemas, public-contract package, compatibility/versioning, authorization, idempotency, audit, threat model, and local DB-backed conformance tests. Preserve current SSDLC authority and executor behavior behind compatibility boundaries; deprecated ContextEpoch exists only as an exact read-only projection whose writes reject and whose removal gate is versioned. Define and implement the canonical context-continuation family: immutable ContextContinuationPolicyDefinition separated from scope-bound ContextContinuationPolicyActivation/revocation; ContextCheckpoint, RetrievalReceipt, ContextBundle/verified ContextBundleDelta, and one-use ContinuationDispatch; exact read-only deprecated epoch projection with rejected writes and executable two-minor/90-day next-major removal gate; typed trigger-specific identities binding repository/base/current SHA/worktree/spec/story/criteria/path/validation/root-cause/retry/completion-candidate material; verified stale-base delta exception with mandatory full-bundle fallback; successful non-aborted turn/generation-bound compaction, matching agent_settled, Pi retry phases, and execution-turn completion candidate distinct from canonical closeout; aggregate retry budget/quarantine; and secret, authority, stale, replay, and wrong-workspace rejection.
